summary: myTomorrows is myTomorrows is a Dutch company, which provides patients with access to medicines in development., founded in 2013. Type: startup / scale-up. About 154 employees (LinkedIn page). Not found in the IND sponsor register. 100% of its 1 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.

insights.one_liner: Amsterdam health-tech firm helping patients reach medicines still in development; about 154 staff, English-language roles, but not a recognised visa sponsor.

culture.text: A mid-sized team of about 154 people, headquartered in Amsterdam with offices in New York City and India.
Staff often come from Utrecht University, VU Amsterdam, University of Amsterdam, Groningen and Erasmus, with backgrounds in computer science, economics, biology and biotechnology.
Work mixes a digital platform with hands-on support: Patient Navigators guide patients for free, while pharma companies pay for trial recruitment and access programmes.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised sponsor, so it cannot sponsor a highly skilled migrant visa through the fast-track route.
Its one open job here, a senior software engineering role in Amsterdam, does not require Dutch.
Operates globally with offices on three continents, so international colleagues are part of daily work.

growth.text: Founded in 2013 (LinkedIn says 2012) and now has about 154 employees.
Says it has helped over 14,000 patients, 2,200 physicians and more than 200 sites worldwide.

worth_knowing.text: Its open senior engineering role drew about 200 applicants on LinkedIn on average, so expect competition.
